A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' of the [[Codru-Ji]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[New Jedi Order]] sometime after the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. The four-[[Limb/Legends|armed]] man had fair skin and long, [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair that he wore loose. On one occasion, the man was cornered by a [[BL-39 interrogator droid]], but he fought back wielding a white-bladed [[Shoto lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber shoto]] in each of his upper hands.<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
This individual was created for the ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', a sourcebook for the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', but he went unnamed in the sourcebook, receiving only an illustration and mention in its accompanying caption.
